note: TRUE compares (clip, frame_idx) against the SAME frame_idx in a join built by a different builder from a different pose source; CONTROL shifts by one frame and must be far worse.
headline: 99.8805 % of 1,063,192 shared agent boxes agree EXACTLY (to the joins 4-decimal rounding) with train2400_agents.jsonl -- a DIFFERENT builder, a DIFFERENT pose source, a DIFFERENT corpus. The mis-join(+1) control drops to 0.0667 %.

_retracted_separation_dcx_median_x.why: the TRUE median |dcx| is EXACTLY 0.0, so this ratio is a division by zero dressed as a measurement. It is replaced by the EXACT-AGREEMENT FRACTION, which is bounded in [0,1] and means something. Quoting 695,400,000x would have been a meaningless number with a plausible shape.
